text: the night we decided to close the company
title: Last Meeting
note: I'll paint the room after you both stood up. The lamp you forgot to switch off.
scene: A small meeting room after midnight. One desk lamp still on. Two paper coffee cups, a whiteboard wiped clean except for one word, two chairs pushed back from the table.
caption:
Last Meeting
The decision took four minutes. The lamp stayed on all night.

Commissioned by Diego.

text: my first apartment, the day I moved out
title: Pale Rectangles
note: Not the boxes. The marks on the wall where your pictures were.
scene: An empty studio apartment at night under one bare bulb. A single cardboard box left in the middle of the floor, keys on the windowsill, pale rectangles on the wall where pictures used to hang.
caption:
Pale Rectangles
You took everything. The wall kept the shapes.

Commissioned by Diego.

title: Corridor, 3am
note: I'll paint the chair, not the waiting. The phone face-down says the rest.
scene: An empty hospital corridor at night, one fluorescent light at the far end. A single plastic chair against the wall, a phone lying face-down on it, a paper cup on the floor.
caption:
Corridor, 3am
The phone is face-down so it can't be watched.

Commissioned by Diego.

title: Closed for the Season
note: The bar after the last customer. One string of bulbs nobody turned off.
scene: A beach bar closed for the season at night. One string of bulbs still lit, stacked chairs, a towel forgotten on the railing, the dark sea beyond.
caption:
Closed for the Season
Someone left the lights on for a summer that had already gone home.

Commissioned by Diego.

text: a phone call I didn't answer
title: Six Rings
note: The hallway, the phone back on its hook, and the coat still moving because you'd just walked past it.
scene: A narrow hallway at night. An old landline telephone on a small table under one wall lamp, the receiver on its hook, a coat on the hook by the door still swinging slightly.
caption:
Six Rings
It stopped ringing a moment before this. The coat hasn't settled yet.

Commissioned by Diego.
